title: One verb with a person, one infinitive

sections.title: Szeretek, szeretnék, szoktam
sections.content: You have used the infinitive since *szoktam olvasni*. The rule is always the same: the first verb carries the person, the second stays as it is. *Szeretek úszni* (I like to swim), *Szeretnék kirándulni* (I would like to go hiking), *Szoktam focizni* (I usually play football). With *megy* the infinitive says what you are going to do: *Úszni megyek.* (I am going swimming.) Then the infinitive usually comes first.
Only the first verb takes the person: *szeretek úszni*, not *szeretek úszom*. The infinitive is the same for every person.
